name: agentwares
description: okgate, an MCP policy proxy, set up from inside Claude Code: dry-run first, then spend caps, approvals for destructive tools, a kill switch and a hash-chained audit log. Open source, no account.

plugins.name: okgate
plugins.description: Put okgate in front of this project's MCP servers and read what an agent run did or would have done. /okgate:init runs `npx -p @agentwares/agentguard okgate init`; /okgate:report explains the dry-run report; /okgate:audit shows which CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md rules your coding agents broke; /okgate:hooks sets up hook mode.

plugins.name: agentguard
plugins.description: Deprecated: agentguard is now okgate. Install okgate@agentwares instead; this entry keeps the same skills under /agentguard:* until at least 2027-01-15.
